def read(self, filepath: str, encoding: str='utf-8', state: Optional[
    BlockState]=None) ->Tuple[Union[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]], BlockState]:
    if state is None:
        state = self.block.state_cls()

    state.env['__file__'] = filepath
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        s = f.read()

    s2 = s.decode(encoding)
    return self.parse(s2, state)
